no_adcom_quote.quote: There was no Advisory Committee meeting was held as there were no issues that needed input from the committee.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the EGATEN (triclabendazole) NDA208711 approval. The FDA Multidiscipline Review explicitly states in Section 10 that no Advisory Committee meeting was held because there were no issues that needed input from the committee. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
